Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the WebServing_Expert extracted incomplete lists of the top 10 highest-grossing worldwide and domestic movies from search result snippets rather than obtaining the full and definitive lists directly from Box Office Mojo's website. The reliance on snippets instead of accurately scraping or manually reviewing the source introduced errors that affected the comparison between the two lists. This mismatch led to an incorrect result by failing to validate whether the extracted list accurately represented the top 10 movies from Box Office Mojo.
